'''Michael Donovan''' is a voice actor who portrayed the voices of [[Stormtrooper (First Order)|First Order stormtroopers]], a [[Starkiller Base PA announcer|PA announcer]] on [[Starkiller Base]], and a member of a [[Resistance]] medical team in [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']]. His identity was revealed by [[Matthew Wood]] in a post on [[StarWars.com]].<ref name="Voices">{{SW|url=news/from-blast-that-x-wing-to-traitor-the-voices-of-star-wars-the-force-awakens|text=From "Blast That X-Wing" to "Traitor": The Voices of Star Wars: The Force Awakens}}</ref> He also voiced [[Dooku|Count Dooku]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi|Ben Kenobi]], [[Owen Lars]], [[Quarsh Panaka]], and [[Poggle the Lesser]] in ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Yoda Chronicles]]'' and ''[[LEGO Star Wars: Droid Tales]]''.

'''Michael Daingerfield''' (born [[October 29]], [[1970]]) is a [[Wikipedia:Canada|Canadian]] voice actor who provided the voice of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] in ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Yoda Chronicles]]''.

The same audio was later used in the [[2015]] [[canon]] read-along storybooks of the Original trilogy.<ref name="ANH" />
